scope: Bounded read-only culture/history/public-art/science/garden source research for US5000-net-new plan. No repository edits, database access, live AI, accounts, paid services, imports or external writes.

tier_definitions.T1: Discovery only: identity/source evidence may exist, rights or public entry/location/current facts unresolved. Not exposed as verified or routed.
tier_definitions.T2: Verified identity/location/public visitor eligibility with cleared fact redistribution, stable source ID, evidence timestamps and field confidence. Unknown hours/cost/accessibility remain unknown. May be exposed with precise status; no route commitment.
tier_definitions.T3: T2 plus operator-current visit/access status, acceptable arrival point and safe route approach, scoped schedule/time zone where required by routing, realistic visit duration and routing constraints. Same entities as T2 subset, never additive.

research_sample_warning: First-N convenience samples diagnose failure modes only; do not estimate national acceptance probabilities from them. Counts do not validate access, closures, commercial rights, entrances or facts.
portfolio_assessment: Culture can plausibly contribute roughly1000–2000 T2 net entities after rights and operator-led pilots, of which roughly500–1200 might becomeT3. This is conditional engineering planning, not measured yield; do not sum source ranges or use to promise5000 route-ready. Only reconciled distinct destination counts support milestones. Texas/ASTC direct reuse zero; NYC/Chicago/APGA/Seattle rights unresolved.
